The movie released to positive reviews and was declared as a commercial success at the box office.
Nayee Padosan | Nayee Padosan (English: New Neighbour) is a 2003 Bollywood comedy film directed by cinematographer B.H. Tharun Kumar and starring Mahek Chahal, Vikas Kalantri, Anuj Sawhney and Aslam Khan in lead roles.  The movie is partially inspired the Tamil film "Indru Poi Naalai Vaa" and "Chashme Buddoor". Simi Chahal | Simi Chahal, (b. 9 May, 1992) born "Simarpreet Kaur Chahal", is a Punjabi film actress from Ambala who predominantly works in Punjabi films. 
I Am Singh | I Am Singh is a 2011 Bollywood film which was released on 2 December 2011.  The film stars Gulzar Inder Chahal, Rizwan Haider and Puneet Issar who also directed the film and wrote the screenplay.  "I Am Singh" portrays the stories of Sikh immigrants in the US after the 9/11 attack.  The film highlights what happened to the immigrants and their fight against prejudice, never losing faith in the American judicial system.
